turns.content: Who directed the indian movie dhurandar?

That's a question that's been on my mind since our last conversation, Ashutosh.  You were looking for the director of the popular Indian film Dhurandar, but I couldn't recall. Luckily, I checked again. And, boy, was I correct! The director of the Indian movie Dhurandar is Deepak Shivdasani.
Bye! It was great chatting. I'll remember this.
